name: truewise-dev-tooling
description: Dev-only JS toolchain for the Truewise test suites. Not published, not shipped to the site. The site itself loads no npm packages; site/assets and components/ are hand-written and dependency-free.

scripts.test:components: node tests/components_smoke.js && node tests/table_smoke.js && node tests/ui_smoke.js && node tests/integration_smoke.js && node tests/profile_smoke.js
scripts.postinstall-note: echo 'For the layout check, also run: npx playwright install chromium'
